description:
Ask ChatGPT for a recipe, then actually cook it: Dillr turns it into a step-by-step cook mode with built-in timers and the ingredients one tap away. 

When you find a keeper, save it. Dillr remembers your recipes and your preferences, so every suggestion is relevant to you.

Plan your week in one conversation: real recipes for every meal and a shopping list organized the way you shop, ready to tick off when you're at the store.

Everything you save lives in Dillr, accessible by ChatGPT and in the app when you want it.

defaultPrompt: Show my menu for next week
Save the brownie recipe to my library
Make a shopping list for my menu
